sourceRefs.locator: ARTEM 4504, Archives nationales K 1 no. 5, transmission, place, regest and ll. 1–3. Address to the duke, the domesticus Gaganricus and the agents, the estate and its former owners. The dated header gives 15 March 633.

DD Mer. 28, pp. 75–77 (Paris plot); 32, pp. 87–89, especially ll. 3–7 (Ursinus, Beppoleno, maternal estate and mancipia; original ratification dated 629–637); 41, pp. 108–110 (Iticina, probably October 632, possibly into 633); 85, pp. 216–218 (royal privilege).
Attestation 1135, place and original wording Clippiaco. The modern identification is Saint-Ouen-sur-Seine; the translation renders the place Clichy. Used for geographical orientation only.

labels.de: Dagobert lässt das Recht an Iticina bestätigen
labels.en: Dagobert confirms Saint-Denis’s right to Iticina

note.de: In Clippiacum ausgestellt, wird die Urkunde in das Zeitfenster 632–633 eingeordnet.
note.en: Issued at Clippiacum, the charter is dated within the years 632–633.
